subject: [PATCH v2 2/5] btrfs: split btrfs_insert_delayed_dir_index() into prealloc and commit phases

reviews.author: Qu Wenruo
reviews.summary: Reviewer Qu Wenruo noted that the current implementation of btrfs_dir_index_prealloc uses a stack-based approach for memory allocation, but suggested converting to a heap-based solution to simplify lifespan management and make code more common and straightforward.

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch splits the btrfs_insert_delayed_dir_index function into two separate phases: preallocation and commit. This change allows for more efficient memory allocation, as it avoids allocating a large block of memory on the stack. The approach taken is to break down the existing function into smaller, more manageable pieces.
